title: Google Workspace Adoption, Change Management & Training Program (Enterprise)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Google Cloud / identity / Gemini enablement).

Google Cloud Console / gcloud / Cloud Identity / Google Admin authored at exact detail from Google public docs; version- or preview-dependent capabilities (SCC tiers, BeyondCorp features, org-policy constraints, VPC-SC behaviors, Gemini Enterprise features) cited or flagged 'verify in your organization', never invented. IaC (Terraform / Cloud Foundation Toolkit) at the pattern level. Automation is Python (gcloud / Cloud Client Libraries) — no hardcoded credentials, no committed service-account keys, no secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Turn a Google Workspace cutover into real, measured adoption
problem: A technically flawless migration still fails if 150,000 users don't change how they work. This solution is the adoption, change-management & training program: stakeholder and champion networks, an OCM plan (awareness → training → reinforcement), role-based learning paths (Gmail/Drive/Docs/Meet/Chat, and Gemini where licensed), a support/floorwalker model for hypercare, and adoption metrics — the human side that makes the M365→Google move actually stick.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the OCM model: stakeholders, champions, the awareness→training→reinforcement arc, role-based paths, hypercare, and adoption measurement.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (migration/rollout plan, exec sponsorship, comms channels, training capacity, metrics source).

Implementation Guide — build the champion network, run the comms/awareness campaign, deliver role-based training, stand up hypercare/floorwalking, and track adoption — wave-aligned to the migration, pilot-first.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or provisioning helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/guardrail check, and a scope/config helper — authentic gcloud / Cloud Client Library automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (training delivered, hypercare staffed, adoption metrics trending up) plus Best Practices for sustaining adoption post-cutover.
short: Run the adoption, change-management & training program for a Google Workspace transformation — champions, an OCM plan, role-based training (incl. Gemini where licensed), hypercare, and adoption metrics — so a 150k-user move actually sticks. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
